statement: Help an anonymous beauty shopper discover Bluemercury products, inspect a skincare item, add an available variant to a persistent local bag, and complete a synthetic guest checkout using the local-sandbox payment adapter.
simulations: sim.local-checkout: synthetic address and non-deliverable example.test email only.
sim.local-payment: opaque sandbox-approved, sandbox-declined, or sandbox-retry scenario; no payment credential fields.
out_of_scope: Source-side add-to-cart, populated cart, checkout submission, order, or payment.
Authenticated account, wishlist, rewards, order history, real email, real delivery, Stripe test/live, card, bank, or wallet data.
External analytics, chat, personalization, advertising, A/B testing, publication, push, PR, or deployment.

release_authority.note: Diagnostics are advisory; rights and redistribution status remain unknown.
